name: Ibis
beschreibung: Ibis Innsbruck is located directly adjacent to Innsbruck Main Station, offering unparalleled connectivity to international trains and local transit. The soundproofed and air-conditioned guest rooms feature the brand's contemporary design alongside comfortable Sweet Bed bedding, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Amenities include a 24-hour reception and a welcoming lounge bar serving drinks and light refreshments at any hour. A varied breakfast buffet ensures an energetic start to the day. Innsbruck's historic Old Town, featuring the Golden Roof and imperial palaces, is less than a ten-minute walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Modern hotel directly at Innsbruck Central Station offering prime transit links and proximity to the Old Town.
